  - func: searchsorted.Scalar(Tensor sorted_sequence, Scalar self, *, bool out_int32=False, bool right=False, str? side=None, Tensor? sorter=None) -> Tensor
    acl_op: all_version
    op_api: all_version
    gen_opapi:
      new_params:
        # Comma chain: pre_check and warn must run before right_eff; single entry avoids key-order hazards.
        right_eff: '(op_plugin::searchsorted_validate_scalar_op(sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right, side, sorter), op_plugin::warn_if_searchsorted_scalar_inputs_noncontiguous(sorted_sequence, sorter), op_plugin::resolve_searchsorted_effective_right(right, side))'
      out:
        size: 'c10::SmallVector<int64_t, op_infer::SIZE>{}'
        dtype: 'out_int32 ? at::kInt : at::kLong'
      exec: aclnnSearchSorteds, sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right_eff, sorter, out

  - func: searchsorted.Tensor(Tensor sorted_sequence, Tensor self, *, bool out_int32=False, bool right=False, str? side=None, Tensor? sorter=None) -> Tensor
    acl_op: all_version
    op_api: all_version
    gen_opapi:
      new_params:
        # Functional: out is not a function arg yet when new_params run — use core check only (incl. sorter size).
        right_eff: '(op_plugin::searchsorted_validate_core_no_output(sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right, side, sorter), op_plugin::warn_if_searchsorted_inputs_noncontiguous(sorted_sequence, self, sorter), op_plugin::resolve_searchsorted_effective_right(right, side))'
      out:
        size: self
        dtype: 'out_int32 ? at::kInt : at::kLong'
      exec: aclnnSearchSorted, sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right_eff, sorter, out

  - func: searchsorted.Tensor_out(Tensor sorted_sequence, Tensor self, *, bool out_int32=False, bool right=False, str? side=None, Tensor? sorter=None, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!)
    acl_op: all_version

  - func: searchsorted.Scalar(Tensor sorted_sequence, Scalar self, *, bool out_int32=False, bool right=False, str? side=None, Tensor? sorter=None) -> Tensor
    acl_op: all_version
    op_api: all_version
    gen_opapi:
      new_params:
        # Comma chain: pre_check and warn must run before right_eff; single entry avoids key-order hazards.
        right_eff: '(op_plugin::searchsorted_validate_scalar_op(sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right, side, sorter), op_plugin::warn_if_searchsorted_scalar_inputs_noncontiguous(sorted_sequence, sorter), op_plugin::resolve_searchsorted_effective_right(right, side))'
      out:
        size: 'c10::SmallVector<int64_t, op_infer::SIZE>{}'
        dtype: 'out_int32 ? at::kInt : at::kLong'
      exec: aclnnSearchSorteds, sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right_eff, sorter, out

  - func: searchsorted.Tensor(Tensor sorted_sequence, Tensor self, *, bool out_int32=False, bool right=False, str? side=None, Tensor? sorter=None) -> Tensor
    acl_op: all_version
    op_api: all_version
    gen_opapi:
      new_params:
        # Functional: out is not a function arg yet when new_params run — use core check only (incl. sorter size).
        right_eff: '(op_plugin::searchsorted_validate_core_no_output(sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right, side, sorter), op_plugin::warn_if_searchsorted_inputs_noncontiguous(sorted_sequence, self, sorter), op_plugin::resolve_searchsorted_effective_right(right, side))'
      out:
        size: self
        dtype: 'out_int32 ? at::kInt : at::kLong'
      exec: aclnnSearchSorted, sorted_sequence, self, out_int32, right_eff, sorter, out

  - func: searchsorted.Tensor_out(Tensor sorted_sequence, Tensor self, *, bool out_int32=False, bool right=False, str? side=None, Tensor? sorter=None, Tensor(a!) out) -> Tensor(a!)
    acl_op: all_version
    op_api: all_version

        right_eff: '(op_plugin::searchsorted_validate_tensor_out_op(sorted_sequence, self, out, out_int32, right, side, sorter), op_plugin::warn_if_searchsorted_inputs_noncontiguous(sorted_sequence, self, sorter), op_plugin::resolve_searchsorted_effective_right(right, side))'
